items.title: Ask the AI Agent
items.description: Get answers about your data without building a single filter. Ask about vulnerabilities, workspaces or assets in plain language, and let the agent take action for you, always within what your role allows.

items.title: Faraday MCP, Now On-Premise and More Capable
items.description: On-premise customers can now install the MCP server locally and connect their AI tools to Faraday without internet access. The MCP also gets new tools to upload reports, run security scanners, manage runners and schedules, generate executive reports, and create, edit or delete data in bulk. You can choose which groups of tools to enable (read, write, delete, export, admin), and responses are faster and use fewer tokens.

items.title: Triage Findings with Confidence
items.description: Tell apart what nobody has reviewed yet from what’s been confirmed or dismissed. Mark findings as false positives (they’re closed and stay closed on reimport), triage in bulk or one by one with Triage mode and keyboard shortcuts, and track every decision in the new History tab.

items.title: Set Up Runners Without Leaving Faraday
items.description: Create runners straight from the UI with a new guided wizard that gives you the command to launch the dispatcher and connects it for you. Once it’s running, add, edit, enable, disable or delete its executors remotely, without touching the runner’s host.

items.title: A Clearer View of Your Workspaces
items.description: Workspace cards now lead with the highest severity present and the workspace risk score, with cleaner severity bars and importance stars moved to the footer. A new summary above the grid gives you the big picture of your whole instance at a glance.

items.title: (5.25.3) Faster performance on large instances
items.description: We’ve made several improvements to how Faraday handles data behind the scenes. If your instance has many workspaces with large amounts of data, you’ll notice faster load times and a smoother experience as you navigate the platform.

items.title: (5.25.2) Lighter on your database
items.description: Faraday now opens fewer PostgreSQL connections, with a configurable pool, smarter worker defaults and clearly labeled connections, making it a better fit for shared databases.

items.title: (5.25.1) Security Scanners catalog
items.description:
You can now run security scanners directly from Faraday. The new **Security Scanners** section brings together the scanner catalog included in your license, so you can launch scans and get results straight into your workspace, without any external setup. From this section you can:

- Run scans on demand from the scanners available for your plan.
- Schedule recurring runs with their own schedule, so scans keep running - without manual work.
- Review your run history to check past runs and their status.

The available scanners and the number of runs depend on your license type. Both manual and scheduled runs count toward the same allowance.

items.title: Take Control of Risk Scoring
items.description: Stop settling for one-size-fits-all risk scores. Build named profiles with your own severity weights and multipliers, assign a different one to each workspace, and set a personal default so every workspace you create starts exactly how you like it.

items.title: Reports on Your Schedule, Delivered Your Way
items.description: Weekly Reports is now Report Subscriptions. Choose weekly, biweekly, or monthly delivery, pick the sections that matter to you, and receive reports by email, keep them in Faraday, or both.

items.title: Capture Findings Without Leaving the Page
items.description: Meet Capture to Faraday, our new Chrome extension. Log manual pentest findings right from the page you're testing, with a screenshot attached automatically, and run any online agent against the current target from the same popup. Your data goes straight to your Faraday instance and nowhere else.

items.title: Work Faster with Keyboard Shortcuts"
items.description: Navigate faster with a new platform-wide keyboard shortcuts system; save, cancel, and switch tabs without leaving the keyboard. Press ⌘/ (Ctrl+/) anytime to see the shortcuts available in your current context.

items.title: New role: Workspace Administrator
items.description: A new built-in role, alongside Administrator, Asset Owner, Pentester, and Client, lets users manage workspaces (create, edit, archive, block, assign users) without full instance-wide admin permissions. Access is scoped only to workspaces where they're an assignee.

items.title: Weekly Reports, Now in Executive Reports
items.description: Manage your weekly workspace report subscriptions from the Executive Reports section; toggle subscriptions for any workspace in one click. Plus, the last 10 generated reports are now saved and downloadable directly from this view, so you're covered even if an email gets lost or your address isn't configured.
